//: These settings are easier to change in-game! Mod List -> Mineral Chance -> Config

Enable Mineral Chance.//: Whether Mineral Chance is enabled. When disabled, none of its features run and its other settings are hidden. Takes effect after a restart.

extraMineralChanceOnOverworldStoneBreak.//: The chance a mineral is dropped when an overworld stone block is broken. By default 1/50. min: 0, max: 1

extraMineralChanceOnNetherStoneBreak.//: The chance a mineral is dropped when a nether stone block is broken. By default 1/100. min: 0, max: 1

enableOverworldMinerals.//: If enabled, mining overworld stone blocks has a chance to drop an overworld mineral.

enableNetherMinerals.//: If enabled, mining nether stone blocks has a chance to drop a nether mineral.

overworldMineralDrops.//: The minerals overworld stone can drop. A higher weight drops more often. Item tags work too, starting with a '#'.

netherMineralDrops.//: The minerals nether stone can drop. A higher weight drops more often. Item tags work too, starting with a '#'.

extraOverworldMineralBlocks.//: Extra blocks that can drop overworld minerals. Block tags work too, starting with a '#'.

extraNetherMineralBlocks.//: Extra blocks that can drop nether minerals. Block tags work too, starting with a '#'.

enableMineralsInOtherDimensions.//: If enabled, stone blocks in other dimensions, such as the end, can drop minerals too.

dimensionsWithoutMinerals.//: Dimensions in which no minerals are dropped.

fortuneChanceMultiplierPerLevel.//: How much each Fortune level increases the mineral chance. 0.5 means +50% per level. min: 0, max: 10

explosionsCanDropMinerals.//: If enabled, stone blocks destroyed by explosions can drop minerals too.

extraMiningTools.//: Extra items that count as a pickaxe, such as mining lasers. Item tags work too, starting with a '#'.

disableMineralDropsWithSilkTouch.//: If enabled, minerals won't drop from stone mined with the silk touch enchantment.

sendMessageOnMineralFind.//: If enabled, sends a message when a mineral is found to the player who broke the stone block.

foundMineralMessage.//: The message sent to the player who found a hidden mineral when 'sendMessageOnMineralFind' is enabled.

ignoreFakePlayers.//: If enabled, minerals won't be dropped if the player is a fake. For example when a mod breaks a block as a simulated player.
